injuries.name: Cutter Gauthier
injuries.note: Gauthier was injured in the first period and ultimately ruled out for the game during the second frame. The 22-year-old's potential absence would be a big one, as he's earned four points over five games to start the season. If Gauthier is out for any stretch of time, A.J. Greer or Nikita Klepov could get chances to fill his top-six role.

injuries.name: Drew Helleson
injuries.note: Helleson isn't expected to play Wednesday versus Edmonton or Friday in Winnipeg, but it sounds like he might be an option for Saturday's game in Calgary. Helleson hasn't played this campaign due to the injury. The 25-year-old is likely to serve on the third pairing once he's healthy, possibly at the expense of Noah Warren.

injuries.name: Troy Terry
injuries.note: Terry isn't expected to be back until mid-November at the earliest, so this transfer doesn't impact his timetable. He had 19 goals and 57 points in 61 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. Terry should occupy a top-six role and play on the first power-play unit once he's healthy.

injuries.name: Drew Helleson
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Anaheim Ducks said that Helleson plans to return on Saturday's (Oct. 10) game versus the Flames, per Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune.

injuries.name: Ian Moore
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Anaheim Ducks placed D Ian Moore on injured reserve on Monday (Sept. 28).

injuries.name: Troy Terry
injuries.note: Hip: The Anaheim Ducks placed F Troy Terry on long-term injured reserve on Wednesday (Sept. 30).

injuries.name: Garrett Brown
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Winnipeg Jets placed D Garrett Brown on injured reserve and he'll now be reevaluated in a couple of weeks.

injuries.name: Walker Duehr
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Winnipeg Jets placed F Walker Duehr on injured reserve non-roster list on Tuesday (Sep. 29).

injuries.name: Josh Morrissey
injuries.note: Upper Body: Morrissey is OUT for Friday's (Oct. 9) game versus the Ducks.

injuries.name: Elias Salomonsson
injuries.note: Shoulder: The Jets said on Friday (Oct. 9) that Salomonsson is now cleared for full contact and is getting closer to return.
